word.definition: Compunction refers to a feeling of misgiving, that is, doubt or suspicion especially concerning a future event.

sports_fact.text: On October 20, 1968, Dick Fosbury won Olympic high jump gold going over the bar backwards. The 'Fosbury Flop' was mocked at the time; today every elite jumper uses it.
